```{r, warning=FALSE}
get_half_year <- function(date) {
  y <- lubridate::year(date)
  h <- ifelse(lubridate::month(date) <= 6, 1, 2)
  return(paste(y, "H", h, sep = ""))
}

df_panel = read_csv("/Users/jimmyzheng0516/Desktop/FDIC/Cleaned_Data/df_panel_lag_final.csv", show_col_types = F)
region = read_csv("/Users/jimmyzheng0516/Desktop/FDIC/Cleaned_Data/region.csv", show_col_types = F)
rate_history = read_csv("/Users/jimmyzheng0516/Desktop/FDIC/Cleaned_Data/rate_hike_history.csv", show_col_types = F)

region$stalp = region$Abbreviation
region = region[, -c(1,3,4,5)]

df_panel = pdata.frame(df_panel, index = c("cert"))
df_panel = as.data.frame(df_panel)
df_panel = df_panel[, -41]
df_panel_reg = df_panel[-c(which(df_panel$Total_Deposits==0)), ]
df_panel_reg = merge(df_panel_reg, region, by = "stalp")
df_panel_reg_period = merge(df_panel_reg, rate_history, by = "repdte")
df_panel_reg = pdata.frame(df_panel_reg, index = c("cert"))
df_panel_reg$time = as.numeric(df_panel_reg$time)
```

```{r}
# Convert the "repdte" character variable to a Date object using the mdy() function from lubridate
df_panel_reg$newdate <- mdy(df_panel_reg$repdte)

# Create a new variable "year_quarter" using the year() and quarter() functions from lubridate
df_panel_reg$year_quarter <- paste(year(df_panel_reg$newdate), "Q", quarter(df_panel_reg$newdate), sep = "")

# Calculate the number of quarters between the first date in your data (12/31/1992) and each observation
start_date <- mdy("12/31/1992")
df_panel_reg$time <- (year(df_panel_reg$newdate) - year(start_date)) * 4 + quarter(df_panel_reg$newdate) - quarter(start_date) + 1

# Extract the year from the first date in the dataset
first_year <- year(min(df_panel_reg$newdate))

# Create the "year" variable
df_panel_reg$year <- year(df_panel_reg$newdate) - first_year + 1

# Drop unnecessary column
df_panel_reg = df_panel_reg[, -44]

df_panel_reg$yearqtr <- as.yearqtr(df_panel_reg$repdte, format = "%Y Q%q")

df_panel_reg2 = df_panel_reg # for data merging
```

```{r}
# Construct a panel dataset with predictors
predictors_data_modified <- predictors_data %>%
  rename_with(~ ifelse(. == "time", ., paste0(., "_pred")), everything())

merged_data <- left_join(df_panel_reg2, predictors_data_modified, by = "time")

merged_data2 = merge(df_panel_reg2, predictors_data, by = "time")

predictors_data3 = predictors_data[, -c(2:6)]

merged_data3 = merge(merged_data2, predictors_data3, by = "time")

names(merged_data3)

merged_data3[, 28:39] = merged_data3[, 28:39] / as.numeric(merged_data3$Total_Deposits)

merged_data4 = merged_data3[, -c(45, 3)]

write_csv(merged_data4, "merged_panel_data.csv")
```

```{r}
# Load the dataset containing interest rates and control variables
library(readxl)
df_additional_data <- as.data.frame(read_excel("Additional_data.xlsx"))
df_additional_data = df_additional_data[, -13]
```

```{r}
# Convert to proportions
df_panel_reg[, 27:38] = df_panel_reg[, 27:38]/ as.numeric(df_panel_reg$Total_Deposits)

# Group the dataframe by 'time' variable and calculate mean values for columns 26 to 38
quarterly_averages <- df_panel_reg %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarize(across(26:38, mean, na.rm = TRUE))

# Convert the result to a dataframe
df_quarterly_averages <- as.data.frame(quarterly_averages)

merged_data = merge(df_quarterly_averages, df_additional_data, by="time")
```

```{r}
# Group the dataframe by 'time' variable and count the unique number of banks
banks_per_quarter <- df_panel_reg %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarize(num_banks = n_distinct(cert))

# Convert the result to a dataframe
df_banks_per_quarter <- as.data.frame(banks_per_quarter)

merged_data = merge(merged_data, df_banks_per_quarter, by="time")

merged_data[, 29] = merged_data[, 29]/as.numeric(merged_data$num_banks)

writexl::write_xlsx(merged_data, "merged_data.xlsx")
```
